title: Trump call with Taiwanese president on hold
description: When Trump visited China earlier this month, Chinese President Xi Jinping warned him that Taiwan could become a "very dangerous situation" if mishandled.

title: US and China trade journalist expulsions in tit-for-tat moves
description: The Trump administration has revoked the visa of a Chinese national working for the state news agency Xinhua in the U.S. This move follows Beijing's decision to expel Vivian Wang, a New York Times correspondent, apparently over a DealBook event featuring Taiwan's leader.

title: India’s ‘unsinkable carrier’ near South-east Asia - and its China calculation
description: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz taught India what strategic exposure costs. Read more at straitstimes.com.

title: Asia defense summit opens with China and doubts about U.S. priorities topping concerns
description: Vietnam’s leader said Friday that the Strait of Hormuz has shown how one flashpoint can throw the rest of the world into turmoil, suggesting that the U.S. and China need to abide by international law to avoid provoking a global crisis as they vie for influence in the Asia-Pacific region.

title: Reading between China’s red lines
description: Xi’s blunt warning to Trump on Taiwan intended to sharpen distinction from past ultimatums. But expanding non-negotiable positions shrinks space for effective diplomacy

title: Canada committed to deepening ties with China, Anand tells Chinese minister
description: OTTAWA — Just days after a Canadian warship passed through the Taiwan Strait — defying Beijing's warning that such transits undermine the bilateral relationship — Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand welcomed her Chinese counterpart Wang Yi to Ottawa

title: Why the Strait of Hormuz worries China more than Malacca
description: China News: China’s key maritime vulnerability starts at the Strait of Hormuz rather than the Strait of Malacca, creating a fresh arena of strategic competition i.

title: China leaders skip Asia defense summit headlined by Hegseth
description: SINGAPORE — United States Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is the headline speaker at Asia’s premier defense summit that opened on Friday, but China’s top officials weren’t expected despite weighty questions like Taiwan and the war on Iran.

title: A lesson America has never learned
description: EVERYBODY knows that as a result of the five-year civil war in China, the Communist Party of China gained political control, establishing the People’s Republic of China (PRC) in 1949. But the Kuomintang forces had not been totally defeated. They retreated to Taiwan (then Formosa) and there continued to maintain what necessarily was a continuing political and economic social setup — the Republic of China (ROC).

title: US arms sales pause would push Taiwan toward asymmetric-defense tech: Analysts
description: The idea of Trump using arms sales as a negotiating chip with China has sparked concerns that Washington might decline procurement deals with Taiwan.
